name: REALTIME QA
description: REALTIME QA is a dynamic question answering platform that evaluates systems on a weekly basis with questions about current world events and novel information. It challenges static assumptions in open-domain QA by requiring up-to-date answers and highlights the importance of real-time information retrieval.
reputation: A notable dynamic QA benchmark for measuring freshness and real-time retrieval ability, though it is less established than long-running static QA datasets.
notes: Ongoing benchmark with weekly updates; focuses on real-time, up-to-date question answering.
